heard: This country is 24 times longer than it is wide. Chile runs 4,270 km from top to bottom. It starts in one of the driest deserts on earth and ends among glaciers. Slide it over Europe and it reaches from the top of Norway past the bottom of Spain. But side to side, it averages just 177 kilometers. So why is it so thin? On one side, the Pacific Ocean. On the other, the Andes, the longest mountain range on any continent. You see, in 1881, Chile and Argentina signed a border treaty. The line would follow the highest peaks of the Andes. So Chile kept the narrow strip between the mountains and the sea. It's not a strange shape, it's the edge of a continent.
